forehead.line: My fan was folded up and grazing my forehead
stanza: My cheeks were reflecting the longest wavelength
My fan was folded up and grazing my forehead
And I kept touching my neck to guide your eye to where
I wanted you to kiss me when we find some time alone

forehead.line: Escaped sound like a kiss upon the forehead
stanza: Sacred Heart
Surveyed from the summit
A pantheon, distant as ever
Echoing up the mountainside
Escaped sound like a kiss upon the forehead
Everything is pale and shining here
The sun's biting my forehead
Oh, water shines too
I fear it could swallow me whole
The constant wind
Washes everything near
So, I forgot what they said
Reeds glistening with dew
So sleek
I feel far from the shoals

forehead.line: When the fever hits on your forehead
stanza: When the fever hits on your forehead
And trusive mice chew up your bed
And you call on God and God is dead
Love comes to you
Love comes to you

forehead.songTitle: Your Flag Decal Won’t Get You Into Heaven Anymore
forehead.line: And one on my wife's forehead
stanza: Well, I went to the bank this morning
And the cashier said to me
"If you join the Christmas club
We'll give you ten of them flags for free."
Well, I didn't mess around a bit
I took him up on what he said
And I stuck them stickers all over my car
And one on my wife's forehead
